$comment: Which standards domains each plugin ships. Generator input only - neither harness reads this file. It is not derivable from anything else: a plugin's name does not imply its domains, and a consumer installs per stack, so the split is a deliberate authored decision. The generator cross-checks it against marketplace.json both ways, so a plugin cannot be declared here and missing there, or the reverse. The 10 utility skills own no doc and ship in no plugin - they are Tommy's machine tooling, delivered by deploy-skills.ps1 from this clone.
